# DropSpace 1.2

<!-- update-summary: Adds a shared six-bar music spectrum, optional album-cover colors for the Island, and synchronized lyric timing, interlude dots and next-line previews in the music window. -->

## Since 1.1

- Six audio-reactive bars follow the selected player in the compact Island, expanded Island, music page and independent music window. The Island keeps its animation in progress when it expands or collapses.
- Turn on **Match Island spectrum to album artwork** under Music to color the Island bars from the cover. Color selection groups related hues so that artwork with dark margins can still show its distinctive accent.
- The music window now follows the Island’s lyric timing and next-line selection. Open it during an interlude to see the waiting dots immediately. Short line changes retain their focus, and pausing, resuming or seeking across a gap updates both views.

## Windows downloads

Choose the per-user installer (DropSpaceSetup.exe), portable application (DropSpace.exe), or MSIX package (DropSpace-x64.msix). Windows x64 build 20348 or later is required. The Windows packages are unsigned and Windows may display a SmartScreen or trust prompt. SHA-256 hashes are included with this release. Portable updates use manual replacement.

v1.1.0 is the immediate upgrade baseline and the previous Stable release. The optional local AI lyric models retain their existing experimental status and are disabled by default.
